title: Glowing flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glowing rim of pot -->
  <rect x='28' y='55' width='44' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffcf66'/>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M32 63 L68 63 L62 88 L38 88 Z' fill='#e07b3c'/>
  <!-- pot body shading -->
  <path d='M32 63 L44 63 L42 88 L38 88 Z' fill='#f29a55'/>
  <!-- pot bottom highlight -->
  <path d='M62 88 L38 88 L39 84 L61 84 Z' fill='#ffb877'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#6b4a9e'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='48' y='38' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#5ad46b'/>
  <!-- leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='44' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#4fc262' transform='rotate(-25 38 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='47' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#6ee87f' transform='rotate(25 63 47)'/>
  <!-- petals -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='7' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='28' r='7' fill='#ff7ba6'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='28' r='7' fill='#ff7ba6'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='7' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='7' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='7' fill='#ffb3cf'/>
  <!-- flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
</svg>
